overview: The council referred proposed ordinances on meeting video recording, commercial security grates, and donation drop boxes to subcommittees. It also approved inquiries regarding housing authority emergency preparedness, gas leaks, and recent power outages.

items.title: One Mission Buzz Off Presentation
items.summary: Fifth-grade teacher Anthony Petrelis spoke on the upcoming One Mission Buzz Off fundraiser honoring former student Hemal Duferrage, after which the council received and placed the presentation on file.

items.title: Resolution on Video Recording Rules
items.summary: The council referred a resolution to amend council rules regarding public video recording under the Open Meeting Law to the Committee on Rules.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Emergency Preparedness
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting emergency evacuation plans and information from the Medford Housing Authority and city emergency officials regarding backup generators for elevators during power outages.

items.title: Natural Gas Leaks in Medford
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a report and council appearance from National Grid regarding the monitoring and repair of over 260 grade 3 natural gas leaks in the city.

items.title: Security Bars and Grates Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance regulating commercial and industrial window security grates and bars to the Subcommittee on Zoning and Ordinances.

items.title: Donation Drop Boxes Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed regulatory ordinance on donation drop boxes to the Subcommittee on Zoning and Ordinances following discussion on protecting existing school PTO textile recycling programs.

items.title: National Grid Power Outages and Booms
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the city administration to contact National Grid regarding recent power outages, explosive sounds, and improved public communication.

items.title: Condolences and Firefighter Promotions
items.summary: The council approved condolence resolutions for Thomas Howell and Johnny Marr, and congratulated firefighters Anthony Meyer and Stephen Blute on their promotions to lieutenant and captain, respectively.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the records of the March 21, 2017 meeting for one week due to a noted error.
